field_notes.GRANT_STATE: Reads constructed 10 MHz DCI bitfields; TBS is derived from the configured MCS/RB table, not an independently decoded over-air field.
field_notes.RX_STATE: Records input/stored NDI, RV, TBS, round and context-reset decision after receiver setup.
field_notes.RATE_STATE: clear_soft_buffer is the Boolean argument supplied to rate unmatching (RV==0). This is separate from receiver context reset.
field_notes.SEGMENT_STATE: decode_iterations is the actual decoder return value. rate_status=-1 marks rate-unmatching failure; 0 marks the normal branch, not its literal function return value.
field_notes.POST_STATE: Records final-segment abort/status/round before completion cleanup.
